# Context Action Menu

Components · Live demo & interactive props: `/cumulus#/context-action-menu`

Real consumers: **0** (imports outside `src/cumulus/docs/` and tests).

The strict pointer/card command offering: a clamped desktop context menu and a responsive dialog sheet with the same typed hierarchy.

> **Guidance:** Use this for card and pointer actions. Cumulus owns focus, keyboard navigation, submenu behavior, outside/Escape dismissal, material, collision handling, and the narrow dialog presentation.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `string` | yes | — | Describes the card/pointer subject in the menu's header. |
| `subtitle` | `string` | no | — | Optional structured secondary location/context copy. |
| `actions` | `readonly CommandMenuItem[]` | yes | — | Commands available for the activated card or pointer target. |
| `anchor` | `ContextActionMenuAnchor` | yes | — | Semantic location used to anchor the desktop pointer menu. |
| `onDismiss` | `() => void` | yes | — | Called after a leaf command, outside dismissal, or Escape. |
| `testId` | `string` | no | — | Optional test selector for the root offering. |

### `anchor`: the `ContextActionMenuAnchor` model

| Field | Type | Optional | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` | `"point" \| "sourceRect"` | no |  |

## Usage

Pass an activation point or source rectangle and typed commands. The component chooses the pointer menu or mobile dialog treatment.

```tsx
import { ContextActionMenu } from "src/cumulus/components/overlay/CommandMenus";

<ContextActionMenu
  title="Card actions"
  actions={cardActions}
  anchor={{ kind: "point", x: event.clientX, y: event.clientY }}
  onDismiss={closeMenu}
/>
```
